description: Header file defining functions, enums, and data structures for calculating MCS and TBS for PDSCH and PUSCH in 5G NR scheduling, including error handling and utility functions.

classes.name: sch_mcs_tbs
classes.description: Container for MCS and TBS results, including the MCS index and TBS size in bytes.

methods.name: compute_dl_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates the downlink MCS and TBS ensuring the effective code rate does not exceed 0.95.

methods.name: compute_ul_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates the uplink MCS and TBS with error handling if the code rate exceeds 0.95.

methods.name: compute_ul_tbs
methods.description: Determines the uplink TBS for given MCS and PRBs, assuming valid code rate.

methods.name: compute_ul_tbs_unsafe
methods.description: Calculates the uplink TBS without validating the code rate.

methods.name: is_pusch_effective_rate_valid
methods.description: Checks if the selected MCS, TBS, and PRBs result in a valid effective code rate and UCI.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts compute_ul_mcs_tbs_error enum values to descriptive strings.
